thread:
nina: quick sync on pagers + transports. proposal: keep page-first API, return opaque `bookmark` at page boundary, optional `item_cursor` if client consumed mid-page. default transport = plain HTTP paged GETs. streaming opt-in via `stream: "chunked"` or `stream: "websocket"`.

paul: agree on bookmark + item_cursor. call it `bookmark` to avoid tying to internals. recommend bookmarking format be versioned (e.g., `v1:`).

omar: retries: page fetches idempotent by default, backoff exp+full jitter, base=100ms, max=3s, attempts=4. provide per-call `retry: 'none'` for side-effectful endpoints. prefetch default 0.

nina: ops note: chunked streams can break on old proxies; add server hint `streaming_compatibility: ["proxy-safe"]`. WS for low-latency usecases only.

devops-bot: CI: `pager-tests` expect current retry attempts; update test matrix if changing defaults.

paul: language ergonomics: python/ts: sync pagers + async iterators. go: iterator object with Next()/Page()/Bookmark()/Err(). keep surface minimal.

nina: action items: draft RFC with bookmark semantics, item_cursor rules, retry defaults, stream modes, migration notes for old `cursor` API. will tag you for review.
